svg.text: Deck with the floor opening: full size (1:1), millimetres
18 mm plywood top 440 x 340 with a 200 x 200 opening, on 62 mm tall battens: 80 mm from the table to the deck's top.
The four battens round the opening are flush with its edges all the way down, so the opening is a square pocket 80 mm deep to the table.
Simulation numbers: every size shown except the batten width (38 mm, a build choice; the simulation fills the whole space under the plywood)
and the screw positions (suggested). Dashed brown: battens under the plywood. Dashed red: the scoring square to draw on the deck's top.
from the midpoint between the arm bases
opening 200 x 200, cut square to the line
scoring square 230 x 230 (15 outside each edge)
+ countersunk wood screw down into a batten, head flush with the deck's top (suggested positions)
Robot side. Top of the page is away from the robot (+x); the left of the page is the robot's left (+y).
SECTION A-A (along y, through the opening)
long batten beyond: the pocket's far wall
SECTION B-B (along x, through the opening)
100 mm check bar: must measure 100 mm on the print (print at 100 %, no fit-to-page)
